metric_definition.pass_play_snaps: Observed team dropbacks on which the player is listed among nflverse offensive participants.
metric_definition.eligible_team_dropbacks: Team dropbacks in player-weeks with at least one observed offensive dropback participation. Inactive weeks are not silently added to the denominator.
metric_definition.pass_play_participation: pass_play_snaps / eligible_team_dropbacks. This is on-field participation on dropbacks, NOT routes run and NOT route participation.
metric_definition.target_rate_per_pass_play_snap: historical targets divided by observed pass-play snaps; this is NOT labeled targets per route run.

identity_policy: offense_players GSIS IDs are mapped to position with the nflverse player master so 2021-2022 NGS and 2023-2025 FTN participation use one stable identity/position method.

source_policy.true_route_validation: Fantasy Life Utilization Game Log primary when available; StatRankings secondary only
